subject.title: fix(chat): preserve explicit current-source sends in Control UI history

question: Should an explicit message send whose resolved channel, account, target, and thread exactly match the source conversation be treated as that session's visible assistant reply in Control UI history?
rationale: The code and proof support the implementation, but automation cannot own the product/session-state contract that converts a transport send into a visible session message.

options.title: Accept exact-route association
options.body: Land the marker-backed projection after refreshing the branch and exact-head checks, accepting the narrowly tested session-state risk.

options.title: Require a broader history contract
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define one generic persisted delivery-to-session association shared by message sends and future announcement paths.

recommendation.title: Accept exact-route association
recommendation.body: Land the marker-backed projection after refreshing the branch and exact-head checks, accepting the narrowly tested session-state risk.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged message-tool routing work is the closest current ownership signal for deciding this association contract.
